---
title: "Island Comparison"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("setup.R")

# Species counts per island
island_species <- penguins_clean |>
  count(island, species) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = species, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

scatter_height <- "500px"

make_island_scatter <- function(data, island_name, xvar, yvar, xname, yname) {
  data |>
    filter(island == island_name) |>
    group_by(species) |>
    e_charts_(xvar, height = scatter_height, width = scatter_height) |>
    e_scatter_(yvar, symbol_size = 8) |>
    e_tooltip() |>
    e_x_axis(name = xname, scale = TRUE) |>
    e_y_axis(name = yname, scale = TRUE) |>
    e_title(text = paste(island_name, "Island")) |>
    e_color(unname(species_colors)) |>
    e_color(background = "transparent") |>
    e_toolbox_feature(feature = "saveAsImage")
}
```

Compare penguin populations and measurements across the three islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Species Composition

```{r}
island_species |>
  e_charts(island) |>
  e_bar(Adelie, stack = "total") |>
  e_bar(Chinstrap, stack = "total") |>
  e_bar(Gentoo, stack = "total") |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_x_axis(name = "Island") |>
  e_y_axis(name = "Count") |>
  e_title(text = "Species Composition by Island") |>
  e_legend(
    show = TRUE, orient = "horizontal", left = "center", bottom = 0
  ) |>
  e_grid(bottom = 80) |>
  e_color(unname(species_colors)) |>
  e_color(background = "transparent") |>
  e_toolbox_feature(feature = "saveAsImage")
```

## Bill Length vs Depth

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Biscoe", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "Bill Length (mm)", "Bill Depth (mm)")
```

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Dream", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "Bill Length (mm)", "Bill Depth (mm)")
```

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Torgersen", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "Bill Length (mm)", "Bill Depth (mm)")
```

## Flipper vs Mass

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Biscoe", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "Flipper Length (mm)", "Body Mass (g)")
```

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Dream", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "Flipper Length (mm)", "Body Mass (g)")
```

```{r}
make_island_scatter(penguins_clean, "Torgersen", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "Flipper Length (mm)", "Body Mass (g)")
```
